{{Youmay|the species from [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]]|the [[Burning Snake (constellation)|constellation]] visible from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}
'''Burning snakes''' were three-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] serpents from [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]]. They absorbed the heat from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]] and converted it into nourishment. They could also use the absorbed heat as a defense mechanism, radiating the collected energy into heat waves that could scald anyone within range. Multiple burning snakes working together would throw off massive waves of super hot energy.
